entries.title: The end of a card's thread stays in view as the message box grows on your iPhone
entries.body: On your iPhone, the first mate's answer at the end of a card's thread could now and then end up under the card's lower edge when the message box below grew to show that same answer. A thread you are reading at its end now keeps its end in view while the message box, the keyboard or the card's foot changes size.
entries.noPicture: The thread looks as it did; only an answer that was sometimes hidden under the card's edge now stays in view.
